description.value: Rigorous training pushes your body's limits further. You gain proficiency in medium armor — or, if you already have it, in heavy armor instead — and while wearing light or medium armor you may calculate your AC using your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice) in place of Dexterity. Your hit point maximum also increases by 3, plus another 1 point every time you gain a level in this class thereafter.
